title: Scrum flashcards: the 2020 Scrum Guide
description: The whole 2020 Scrum Guide as flashcards: theory, the Scrum Team, the artifacts, the events and the values, each idea taught before it is tested.

startHere.what: Scrum is a lightweight framework for complex work: a small team works in fixed cycles of a month or less, called Sprints, and inspects and adapts both the product and its way of working as it goes.
startHere.problem: When the work is complex, what will happen cannot be known in advance. Scrum replaces long up-front plans with short cycles, so decisions rest on what has actually happened.
startHere.scenario: A team of seven building a booking app keeps one ordered list of everything the product needs. Every two weeks it picks a goal, builds a usable piece toward it, shows the result to the people who will use it, and changes its plans and its habits based on what it learns.

changelog.notes: First draft, not yet released: awaiting the independent source audit, a novice read-through and an expert review.

checks.what: An independent audit read all 141 cards against the text of the 2020 Scrum Guide
checks.result: It found no card wrong. Four explanations that said more than the guide supports, and thirteen minor issues (mostly a card citing the wrong section), were fixed.
